messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: Error in producing pairs diagrams
parts: On Friday, January 13, 2017 at 10:49:25 AM UTC-5, Elaheh Torkashvand wrote:
I ran my code in STAN. However, when I use pairs(), I get the following errors:

Error in plot.new() : figure margins too large


That is just because the RStudio plot window is too small. You can make it bigger with the mouse.

Note that I already have 

dim(fit)

[1] 1006    3 5290


where fit is my stan object. Any help will be much appreciated.

You are going to have to choose which pairs of parameters to (not) plot using the pars and possibly the include argument to pairs(). You are not going to be able to visualize 5290^2 plots and your computer will probably run out of memory anyway.

Ben
